history.summary: POSSIBLE DUPLICATE of seq 717 / 'Saiha Kali Mandir' - the only Hindu shrine in Saiha with substantive published coverage (New Colony Veng, PIN 796901). Both CSV rows almost certainly refer to the same Kali temple serving the local Bengali Hindu community; there is no evidence of a second distinct Kali temple in Saiha. Kept as a separate file with a unique id; dedup against seq 717 recommended. The temple is described as a modest modern concrete structure with an orange-and-white facade on a small hillock overlooking the town, in a North Indian style with a local Mizo-influenced sloping roof. The listing's claims of an ASI survey and of a 'Bengal Renaissance Period' origin are almost certainly spurious and should not be repeated as fact. No founder, builder or dynasty is documented. Coordinates (22.49023, 92.98058) are town/locality-level (verify). No reliable image of the actual temple was found after genuine searching (the Google place-photo link behind a crowdsourced listing's thumbnail failed to load).

name: Kali Mandir
town_description: Saiha (officially Siaha) is the district headquarters of Saiha district in southern Mizoram, near the Myanmar border, and the principal town of the Mara Autonomous District Council. Home to the Mara tribe, who are overwhelmingly Christian, it is one of Mizoram's fastest-growing towns. A small Hindu minority - Bengali traders, government staff and paramilitary personnel - maintains the town's few community temples.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl), approx. 300-315 km by road / about 5 hours (verify). Pawan Hans helicopter service links Aizawl and Saiha (verify current operation).
travel.railway: Nearest railhead not reliably published (verify); candidates include Bairabi (Mizoram) and Ambassa/Dharmanagar (Tripura).
travel.road: Approx. 378 km from Aizawl via NH 54 (per Wikipedia), with regular buses and jeeps.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for weather (15-25 C); Kali Puja / Durga Puja season for festivals (verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Listed as 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00-9:00 PM daily, free entry (verify - single uncorroborated crowdsourced listing).
